sentences.text:
2. Issue notice to the respondent-State, returnable on 03.10.2019.
3.
The learned A.P.P. waives notice for respondent-State.

4. The learned counsel for the applicant, on instructions, submits that during pendency of the application before the Court below, seeking anticipatory bail, the applicant was protected by an interim order and the said order remained in force till disposal of the main application.

2 905-ABA.1241-19.odt 5. In view of the above, until further orders, in the event of arrest of applicant NOOR RAUF SHAIKH in connection with Crime No.118 of 2019 registered with Sonai Police Station, District Ahmednagar for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code and section 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B.
of Rs.15,000/-(Rupees Fifteen Thousand only), with one surety of the like amount on the following Noor Rauf Shaikh vs The State Of Maharashtra on 20 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161754240/
1 conditions that :-
a] The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 8.00 to 11.00 a.m. till further order.
